name: alltheway
description: AllTheWay monorepo. See docs/ for architecture.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @alltheway/contracts run build && npm --workspace @alltheway/gateway run build && npm --workspace web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @alltheway/contracts run typecheck && npm --workspace @alltheway/gateway run typecheck && npm --workspace @alltheway/scribe run typecheck && npm --workspace web run typecheck
scripts.test:py: cd libs/policy && python -m pytest tests -q && cd ../screening && python -m pytest tests -q && cd ../agentauth && python -m pytest tests -q && cd ../../services/orchestrator && python -m pytest tests -q && cd ../watcher-runtime && python -m pytest tests -q && cd ../profile-synthesizer && python -m pytest tests -q && cd ../research-cell && python -m pytest tests -q && cd ../connector-gateway && python -m pytest tests -q
scripts.guards: python scripts/check-tenant-isolation.py && python scripts/check-image-deps.py && python scripts/check-plan-table.py && python scripts/check-locales.py && python scripts/check-tests-listed.py
